name: lattice-plugin
description: Build sandbox-first Lattice integrations across REST and gRPC. Publish entities, run taskable agents, use the Objects API, and validate against a live environment.

interface.longDescription: Choose REST or gRPC, authenticate to a sandbox, build Lattice integrations in the user's language, verify them live, and explain the Entities, Tasks, and Objects APIs clearly.

Build a REST integration that publishes entities to my sandbox.
